tagline: Squeeze condiment packets, build a packet tower, and invent packets that should not exist.
description:
Packet Baron is a tapping and idle game about a silly condiment packet company. You start with ketchup, mustard, mayo and soy sauce, and margins that are terrible.

How to play: squeeze packets by hand, then buy production lines so the Factory runs without you. Set prices per packet, run marketing campaigns from the Office, and watch your stock stack up as pallets on the floors of the Packet Baron Tower. Spend money in R and D to invent new packets. Some become hits that pay royalties every second. After three inventions the Packet Gallery opens, and after twenty the 50/50 Machine mixes half and half flavors. Holidays, promos, sales crashes and buying frenzies keep the market moving. The goal is one million dollars in lifetime earnings, and the milestones keep going after that.

The free demo plays the full game up to 25,000 dollars in lifetime earnings. Buying it removes the cap so your company can grow to a million and beyond. Progress is saved in your browser.

Plays in your phone or desktop browser.
